title: Little Paws (sweet cute dog theme)
story: A sweet, fluffy little dog: bouncy, curious, playful, wagging tail, makes everyone smile.

brief.notes: Flavour: light, playful slice-of-life with comedy bounce; mickey-mousing allowed. Venu flute and mridangam as support. No vocals.

prompt: Sweet, cute and playful cinematic theme for a fluffy little puppy, bouncy and happy. 118 BPM, light and springy, G major. Lead: a bright plucky synth and a glockenspiel playing a catchy, bouncy 4-bar melody that keeps returning, over a playful bass and light, clean drums with hand claps. Support: pizzicato strings and a ukulele bouncing along, a venu bamboo flute answering the melody with quick happy runs, a mridangam and a kanjira adding light playful fills. Little musical jokes: a cheeky bassoon hop, a xylophone run like a wagging tail, a soft 'boing' slide on the bass. 0-8 s: a curious, tip-toe start with plucks and pizzicato. 8-30 s: the full bouncy melody with all the playful layers. 30-50 s: a bigger, happier chorus, everything bouncing together. 50-60 s: the melody once more and a cute little ending note. Clean, warm, bright and friendly mix, no heavy drums, no dark sounds, no long pauses. Instrumental only, no vocals.
